Card Q&A.a: No, it isn't deleted yet. Once all of the processing for this card's [On Play] [On Deletion] effect is resolved, then all of the Digimon with 0 DP are deleted at the same time.
Card Q&A.q: A Digimon's DP became 0 from this card's [On Play] [On Deletion] effect. At such times, is that Digimon deleted before the rest of this effect's processing is resolved?

Effect: When this card would be played, if [Nature Spirits] is in your face-up security cards, reduce the play cost by 4.
[On Play] [On Deletion] 1 of your opponent's Digimon gets -5000 DP for the turn. Then, delete 1 of their Digimon with 5000 DP or less.
